ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a dominant low-intensity (dark) central area and high-intensity (white) margins along the distal and lateral edges, approximately 4:1 dark-to-light ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patches are concentrated on the distal tips of both lobes. The left lobe exhibits vertical high-contrast white streaks extending from the lower margin. The right lobe distal tip shows a dense, solid white cluster with fine linear intrusions into the central black mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped notch with a narrow vertical cleft; internal angle at the base of the notch is approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible across the entire trailing edge boundary. Amplitude of peaks is most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes, with smaller, tighter valleys near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a sharp convex curve at the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular white pixel groups (barnacles) are densely packed on the extreme outer tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous vertical and diagonal high-contrast linear marks (rake marks) are visible across the dark pigmentation of both lobes, particularly on the inner distal areas.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle encrustation on the distal tips resulting in irregular, jagged physical topography; numerous white linear rake marks across the fluke surface.
